name: Noel
source:
An orphan selling drugs for a gang. She acts like a guy, but does have girlish traits. Currently working as a guide working with [url=/c12330]Romeo[/url]. She knows a lot of Belmonte’s history, which makes her an excellent guide. Stubborn and pretty emotional. Doesn’t agree with Romeo 90% of the time.

[Edited from a [url=http://accany.wordpress.com/2010/01/20/月光のカルネヴァーレ-review/]review[/url] by Accany]
